run.question: I need to find a field in the app-193-telemetry index that's used for tracking transactions. The field name should contain 'transaction'. Can you search the mappings and tell me the exact field name?

report.summary: The exact field in the app-193-telemetry index whose name contains 'transaction' is du_transaction_id_7k3m. It is a top-level text field with an additional keyword sub-field (fields.keyword, type keyword, ignore_above 256). A scan of every path in that index's mapping for the case-insensitive string 'transaction' returned only that field and its own sub-paths (fields, fields.keyword, fields.keyword.type, fields.keyword.ignore_above, type), so no other transaction-named field appears in the mapping. Scope limits: the index listing and mapping reads are point-in-time snapshots taken during this Run (around 2026-11-23T17:56:42Z–17:56:50Z), the index listing reports docs.count 1, and a mapped field is not proof that stored documents carry values in it — I did not read any document to confirm population or format.
